Subject Re: Instructions for Apple TV 
Yeah, this is a tough situation. 
Channels on AppleTV are apps. Anyone can install apps on the AppleTV by logging in with their 
Apple IDs (and remember to sign out after), but how each channel handles content licensing is up 
to them -- some have subscription services that you can buy, others require you sign in with a 
partnered cable account, etc. 
For example: 
• for HBO Go (or CNN Go) you have to sign in with a cable account that has the HBO channel 
on the account. 
• for HBO Now, you have to subscribe for $X per month, billed to your Apple ID. 
• for Disney's channels, you have to sign in with an authorized cable account, BUT TimeWarner is 
not one of the options. 
So it's a bit of a mess. 
For Nilli & Ehud I signed into one of the news channels as the account connected to 9 E 71st, but 
each cable account can only be on 5 devices at once (and Jeffrey has A LOT of devices he uses 
personally). 
I'm not sure what the solution is here. I'll think on it, but I may need some guidance from Rich & 
JEE on how they want this to work. 
Thank you,

How to save videos offline

disabled.

you attempt to save the video. Don't worry,

youtube-offline ) 
How to save videos offline 
I) Launch YouTube on your iPhone or iPad and start watching a 
video. 
2) Pause the video, then tap the Save button. 
The button resembles a downward-pointed arrow and can be 
found below the video player 
(or under the Details tab in the 
YouTube Gaming app). 
3) Choose a desired video quality from the popup menu, then hit 
OK. 
If the video is unavailable for offline playback, the button will 
appear disabled. 
Tip: Tick the box next to "Remember my settings" if you don't 
want to be asked to select video 
quality every time you attempt 
to save the video. Don't worry, 
you can change this behavior at 
any time in YouTube's settings. 
Your video begins downloading to the device. It will remain 
offline for up to 30 days. If your 
device loses connectivity while 
saving a video offline, it will 
automatically resume as soon as 
it regains network connectivity. 
Let me know if this isn't working for some reason.
